to: two shapes of today disagree by up to a day

UTC, not the local day: the stamp travels in the repository and is read on machines in other zones, so it has to answer 'which day was it', not 'which day was it where the writer sat'. A reader's own day can be rendered from an unambiguous stamp; the zone a local stamp was written in is recorded nowhere, so the reverse is impossible. One implementation, scripts/today.mjs, imported by every writer.
